svg.title: DevHub logo round 2 / Sonnet
svg.text: Hub with plug-in slots, refined and combined with Folio and Shift. Graphite Neon only. Every favicon is a native 16px raster with an 8x pixel zoom beside it.
Hub refinement · Four modules docked on a lime core. The literal mark, drawn tight.
Hub refinement · Each module has a slot. The lime core carries a plug into every one.
Hub refinement · A lime cross runs through the hub. The modules sit on its four ends.
Folio + Hub · Folio's silhouette, split into four modules around a lime core. The cut corners are the fold.
Shift + Hub · Shift's offset middle row, ending in a lime hub that has docked in the stack.
Abstract · Four modules turn around the core. A hub without the plus sign.
Abstract · Refined Shift: three bars on the hub's grid, the middle one moved.
Icon tiles are 1024px studies drawn at 16%. Nothing here replaces an installed app icon.
